{
  "name": "loss_softplus_advantage_rank",
  "intuition": "Shift from margin-based pairwise loss with logsigmoid on logprob gaps to a softplus loss using advantage and rank gap signals to emphasize relative ranking rather than fixed margin.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_diff = rank_gap(delta_rank); adv_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l; x = scale * adv_diff - lambda * rank_diff; loss = mean(weight * softplus(-x))",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_rank_based",
    "signal_family": "advantage_rank_gap",
    "link_family": "softplus",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "softplus",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l",
      "delta_rank"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    lam = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('lambda', 0.5))\n    rank_diff = ops.rank_gap(delta_rank)\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    x = ops.sub(ops.mul(scale, adv_diff), ops.mul(lam, rank_diff))\n    loss = ops.softplus(ops.neg(x))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)\n"
}

  "intuition": "rule_based: pairwise logsigmoid loss with shifted aggregation structure using sum then mean",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    # first sum over some dimension (simulate structure shift), then mean\n    loss_sum = ops.sum(loss)\n    loss_final = ops.mean(loss_sum)\n    return loss_final"
}

{
  "name": "loss_tanh_difference_advantage",
  "intuition": "Use a pairwise ranking loss with a hyperbolic tangent transformation to softly saturate the difference in log probabilities weighted by advantage difference, fostering smoother gradients and robustness to outliers compared to margin-based losses.",
  "pseudocode": "diff = lpw - lpl\nadv_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l\nweighted_diff = diff * adv_diff\nclamped = clamp(weighted_diff, -10, 10)\nloss = mean(1 - tanh(clamped)) weighted by 'weight'",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_rank_saturation",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_stabilized"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "clamp",
    "mean",
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "add",
    "neg"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": ["log_prob_w", "log_prob_l", "weight", "advantage_w", "advantage_l"],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    weighted_diff = ops.mul(diff, adv_diff)\n    clamped = ops.clamp(weighted_diff, -10.0, 10.0)\n    loss_vec = ops.sub(ops.ones_like(clamped), ops.tanh(clamped))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_vec = ops.mul(loss_vec, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss_vec)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_diffsigmoid_advantage_reg",
  "intuition": "Use a difference of sigmoid scores weighted by advantage gap and regularized by absolute log-prob difference; encourages separation modulated by preference advantage.",
  "pseudocode": "score_w = sigmoid(lp_w)\nscore_l = sigmoid(lp_l)\nadvgap = advantage_w - advantage_l\nadv_weight = relu(advgap)\nbase_loss = adv_weight * (score_l - score_w)\nreg = abs(lp_w - lp_l) * 0.01\nloss = mean(base_loss + reg) weighted by optional weight",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_differential",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "sigmoid_diff",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "l1_regularization"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "sigmoid",
    "relu",
    "abs",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l\n    adv_weight = ops.relu(adv_gap)\n    score_w = ops.sigmoid(lpw)\n    score_l = ops.sigmoid(lpl)\n    base_loss = adv_weight * (score_l - score_w)\n    reg = ops.abs(lpw - lpl) * 0.01\n    loss = base_loss + reg\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

}

  "intuition": "Shifts paradigm from pairwise margin to a pairwise contrastive framework leveraging exponential differences as affinity scores. Instead of margins or sigmoid-based surrogates, it models soft pairwise preferences by contrasting exponentials of scaled log probability differences, applying a variant of softmax cross-entropy to directly encourage relative ranking with temperature scaling. This creates a smooth, probabilistic contrastive loss that encourages stronger ordering signal without relying on explicit margins or clamps.",
  "pseudocode": "x = alpha * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / temperature\nexp_pos = exp(x)\nexp_neg = exp(-x)\nloss_i = -weight * (log(exp_pos / (exp_pos + exp_neg)))\nloss = sum(loss_i) / sum(weight)",

  },

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-8\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))\n    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    temperature = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('temperature', 0.1))\n\n    x = alpha * (lpw - lpl) / temperature\n    # Clamp x to prevent overflow in exp\n    x = x.clamp(min=-20.0, max=20.0)\n    exp_pos = ops.exp(x)\n    exp_neg = ops.exp(-x)\n    denom = exp_pos + exp_neg + eps\n    softmax_scores = exp_pos / denom\n    loss_per_pair = -ops.log(softmax_scores.clamp(min=eps)) * weight\n    denom_weight = ops.sum(weight) + eps\n    return ops.sum(loss_per_pair) / denom_weight",
